create_dictionary: create a Dictionary instance with custom bos, pad, eos, and unk special symbols
encode_line_to_tensor: encode a text line into a torch IntTensor of token indices using the Dictionary
decode_tensor_to_string: convert a tensor of token indices back to a human-readable string using Dictionary.string
load_dictionary_from_file: load a pre-built dictionary from a text file using Dictionary.load class method
build_dictionary_from_corpus: build a dictionary from a corpus file by adding tokens with Dictionary.add_file_to_dictionary
